title: How far-right AfD breakthrough may ‘cause absolute chaos’ in Germany
summary: Germany’s Alternative for Germany (AfD) came out well ahead in Sunday’s regional elections in the state of Saxony-Anhalt, becoming the first far-right party to come close to gaining power at the regional level since World War II.
